modules.module_title: Prepare the therapy room and required equipment

pcs.pc_description: wear appropriate and clean attire
ensure infection control measures are implemented at all times
dip used glass cups in water containing 2% sodium hydrochloride solution immediately after removal from the solution
carry out routine cleaning of the equipment such as various types of cups, needles, scalpel etc

sterilize the special cups such as massage cups, glass cups, silicon, bamboo cups and Korean cups according to the practitioner's recommendation/Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) guidelines.
check that all the instruments are cleaned/ sterilized
collect the required sterilized and clean equipment for the procedure
carry out the routine maintenance of the treatment/ therapy room

pcs.pc_description: coordinate the appointment schedule between the patient and the practitioner
document call logs, reports, task lists, and schedules electronically to avoid wastage of paper
ensure that the unit is clean before starting the procedure
adopt a gender neutral approach while introducing oneself to the patient and apprising them of the procedure
address patient's queries and doubts
check that all the pre-procedural preparations of the therapy room are done
ensure that the screen partitions are ready
obtain patient's consent for performing dry cupping procedure

modules.module_title: Carry out dry cupping therapy under supervision

pcs.pc_description: ensure the patient is comfortable during draping
position the patient according to the points for cupping
provide assistance while positioning a PwD patient if required
clean the treatment part with an antiseptic liquid before applying the cups.
perform fire cupping with glass cups carefully as there are chances of breakage.
carry out weak/light, medium or strong cupping therapy as prescribed
carry out needle cupping as prescribed
perform Hot Cupping / Moxa Cupping for conditions such as asthma, muscular pains, Dysmenorrhea etc.
carry out massage or moving cupping
carry out water cupping using lukewarm, tap water or cold water
follow the steps to carry out herbal cupping
carry out ice cupping therapy
carry out magnetic cupping therapy with the help of magnetic needles
inform the practitioner immediately in case of any complication like fainting, accidental burning, extensive blistering, and any other adverse reactions.
ensure resource optimisation by reusing the cups if they are in a good condition.
bandage the area if any blisters appear.
clean the area with antiseptic liquid after the treatment.
assist the patient in wearing the clothes
discard the consumables like gauze pieces, needles according to the waste management protocols
guide the patient about the post- procedural restrictions, precautions and the follow-up plans

modules.module_title: Preparation of the patient before wet cupping therapy

pcs.pc_description: coordinate between the attending AYUSH practitioner and patient for appointment schedule.
obtain blood reports to rule out any blood/fluid/ borne diseases like HIV, HBsAg etc. or bleeding tendencies
inform the patient about various pre- procedural formalities like bringing their reports and dietary restrictions (NPO etc)
assist the physician in obtaining medical history and consent
ensure that personal articles of the individual are handed safely to the family members as per organizational policy.
assist the AYUSH practitioner in pre- operative care such as epilating the hairy areas for ease of cup application
assist the AYUSH practitioner to check and record the patient’s vitals
inform the AYUSH practitioner in case of any abnormalities found and act accordingly as per organizational policies.
wear appropriate dress/ uniform as per organizational policies and procedures
prepare the unit and materials required for wet cupping treatment such as putting off the AC and keeping the equipments handy

modules.module_title: Providing support during wet cupping therapy session

pcs.pc_description: acquaint the patient/ client with the wet cupping procedure
position the patient appropriately for the wet cupping therapy procedure
massage the cupping area softly
clean the desired area with antiseptic solution

ensure that aseptic techniques are used like using disposable surgical gloves, sterile cotton, bed rolls, disposable plastic cups, disposable surgical blades, surgical gown, and mask are used for all the processes.
assist the practitioner in creating incisions
inform the attending AYUSH practitioner about any unusual observations during the procedure such as discomfort to the patient etc.
apply the cups on the treatment area with the help of suction gun.
maintain patient’s privacy throughout the procedure.

inform the therapist/practitioner immediately in case of a complication arising after the procedure such as fainting, uncontrolled bleeding, deviations in the vital signs or any other adverse reaction.
clean the cupped area with a suitable antiseptic liquid after the treatment as directed by the practitioner.
bandage the area using a suitable antiseptic liquid.
assist the patient to wear the clothes
guide the patient about specific post- procedure precautions such as strict adherence to diet plan, not to take bath upto 24 hours
inform the patient/ client about the next follow- up schedule in consultation with the AYUSH practitioner

handle, package, label, store, transport and dispose off waste appropriately as per scope of work
follow Universal Precautions to avoid contact with patients' bodily fluids, by wearing Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintaining hand hygiene as and when required

follow incident reporting protocols as per SOPs in incidents such as needle stick injuries etc.
